title: phalangium squameum
intro: Phalangium squameum, commonly known as the Scurvy Grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the genus Cochlearia. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including scurvy, a disease caused by a lack of vitamin C. The health benefits of Phalangium squameum include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antibacterial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory effects.
